description: Module for displaying a 'Waiting for...' dialog using Bootstrap, providing functions to show, hide, and update the dialog.

methods.name: constructDialog
methods.description: Creates the DOM structure for the waiting dialog.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the waiting dialog with customizable message and options.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Closes and removes the waiting dialog.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Gets or sets the current message in the dialog.
